steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Clean and fully dry a 10-inch tube pan.
Sift together flour, and 3/4 cup sugar, set aside.

Whip egg whites, along with vanilla, cream of tartar, and salt, in a large bowl to medium stiff peaks. Gradually add remaining 3/4 cup sugar while continuing to whip to stiff peaks. When the egg white mixture has reached its maximum volume, fold in the sifted ingredients gradually, 1/3 at a time. Do not overmix. Put the batter into the tube pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until the cake springs back when touched, 40 to 45 minutes.
Balance the tube pan upside down on the top of a bottle to prevent decompression while cooling. When cool, run a knife around the edge of the pan and invert onto a plate.

raw_recipe.headline: Angel Food Cake
raw_recipe.description: A classic angel food cake recipe that is light and airy. It tastes great by itself but is also lovely for dessert with whipped cream or fruit.
raw_recipe.name: Angel Food Cake

review.reviewBody: Excellent recipe. When I have a large supply of eggs, this is how I use them. I never have cake flour, so I use 1/8 cup cornstarch and 7/8 cup of all purpose flour.

Excellent recipe!!! I made sure I really whipped the egg whites as other posters had said and this turned out great for me. Instead of make this in the tube pan, I made muffins out of it. The recipe for me made 24 muffins (make sure to use liners or they do stick). I have my muffins currently frozen and I take one down a night for a strawberry dessert. For anyone interested also I am on weight watchers and I calculated the muffins to be about 1 1/2 pts a piece. A great snack :)

So so so so good! MAKE SURE NOT TO MAKE IT IN A BUNDT PAN it will so much get stuck and it won't look as pretty as you want it. Boil two cartons of blackberries, the juice of half a lemon, and half a cup of sugar to make an amazing blackberry syrup on top. Will be making this again.

The first time I made this angel cake is was a disaster so I made two changes. First, I added 1/3 cup of warm water. Second, I lowered the oven temperature to 350 degrees. I did not open the oven door for 35 minutes at which time I inserted a skewer in the cake and it came out clean. The proper tools are very important when making any Angel Food Cake. I used an actual Angel Food Cake Pan, (two piece) and a very sharp knife to remove the cake. If you use an Angel Food Cake Pan, you won't need to balance the cake on a bottle since the Angel Food Cake Pan has three legs that keep the cake suspended. I let it cool for and hour and a half and it came out perfect.

Turned out excellent! I followed it ALMOST exactly...Sugar & cooking time changes.
I saw in some reviews to cut the sugar down a little, which helps because my dad is diabetic. I reduced it to 1/4c less and was still great. Another change is the baking time. I had a slightly smaller springform bundt pan as compared to the standard. Had to take out about 2 cups because my pan would've overflowed while baking and made those into cupcakes. I initially timed the cake for 40min, but thankfully I checked it halfway thru and it was perfectly done already in about 20min! Nice, fluffy & delicious! Served with homemade mixed berry jelly & whipped cream. Addictive & family loves it!

So light and fluffy! I lined the bottom of my pan with parchment paper and used the bottle technique to cool. Turned out great! Served it with a fresh peach topping and whipped cream. My kids are not peach fans, so I topped theirs with fresh strawberries. This is a keeper in my recipes.

If you have a Kitchenaid 5 quart stand mixer, you'll find that when you're beating the egg whites, it will reach the top of the bowl and almost flow over. I made the mistake of trying to fold the flour in the 5 qt bowl and ended up working it too much which resulted in the cake not rising. However, even with the cake only baking to half the size, the taste was wonderful. The next time I will transfer the egg whites to a larger bowl so I will have more room to fold the mixture. I used a little more than 1 cup of sugar instead of 1 1/2 cups. I didn't want too sweet of a cake. The taste was perfect.

I had leftover egg whites and used it on this recipe, however halved the recipe. I made cake flour by taking out 1 tablespoon of flour and adding 1.5 tsp corn starch and sifted it 5-6 times. I didn’t have any cream of tartar on hand so substituted for vinegar. I made cupcakes baking at 350f for about 20 minutes. These turned out pretty good with all the changes.
I made recipe with one adjustment. I did not have cake flour, I substituted 2 tablespoons of cornstarch for 2 tablespoons of the all purpose flour. Came out great ….. no chemicals like the box mixes.

This was my first time to ever make angel food cake & I agree with others that it was much more moist than store bought of mixes! The whole family loved it!. I followed the directions (except substituting 7/8 c flour & 1/8 c of cornstarch for the cake flour) & whipped the egg whites forever. I made 24 muffins (no spray or liners - just soaked the pans afterwards & they came clean easily). Baked @ 375 X 13 minutes. Thanks!

I realize 375 reviews is probably enough, but this turned out perfectly. I have some experience with Passover sponge cakes, and the principles are similar. Whereas those tend to be heavier, yellow, and eggy, this angel food cake was light, bright white, and airy. I set it on a strawberry puree reduction, and frosted with strawberry whipped cream. Then I topped it with halved fresh strawberries. My husband said it was my best cake so far!

Cake turned out fantastic! I baked it at 40 minutes at 375 degrees, but some people may have to bake at 350 because I need to crank my oven up a little to get from scratch cakes baked the whole way through.

I’m so upset. This cake was beautiful after 25 minutes in the oven, but still a little raw inside after testing it with a toothpick. My teen wanted to “follow the directions”, at 40 minutes the top was totally burnt. Black burnt, not just a little overdone. We had another recipe that said 325°, why does this recipe have such a high temp!?!
Very easy to o follow,great taste
I decreased the sugar by 1/4c. liked it better
I found the edges to be tough and it don’t cut well. Probably operator error. Tasted fine.
Very easy to follow

This evening Miamipatty made Snoop Dogg's Chocolate chip cookies here's a photo came out perfect I modified the cookies by adding 4 eggs 1/4 cup of Shortening Wesson 1/2 cup of milk to make Brownies try it Thank Snoop Dogg

Simple and quick, the only thing I did differently ,was to remove the cake after 30 minutes . I didn't have cake flour but I used all-purpose flour and cornstarch. It turned out lovely very pleased with this recipe.
made 3 times so far topped with strawberries and whipped cream. soooo good. entered the 1st cake in fair and won 2nd place ribbon
